ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; no account flag (driver's "I'm Here" press and >3 min wait are corroborated by GPS).

rejected_claims.reason: Driver claims he waited more than 3 minutes, but the trip timeline shows the cancel at 13:05:40, only 2 min 55 s after his 13:02:45 'I'm Here' press (175 s ≤ 180 s). System records override the statement, so NS-1(iii) is not satisfied.
'Waited more than 3 min' is contradicted by the timeline; from the press to the cancel is under three minutes.
